
## Download

Download `ForceBorderlessWindowed.exe` and start it; there is no installer. It needs Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) and the [.NET 10 Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/10.0) (x64). A running older version is asked to exit and the new one takes over.

The exe isn't code-signed yet, so SmartScreen will probably warn you the first time: click "More info", then "Run anyway". `SHA256SUMS.txt` has the checksum of the exe (`sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt`).

If something doesn't work with a game, please open an issue and attach the log (tray menu → Troubleshooting → Open log folder). All changes: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/stuoningur/ForceBorderlessWindowed/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
